verdict.rationale: 1Password's own documented bulk capabilities are import from CSV and other apps, export, and the CLI's `op item list --vault` command, which reads across many items. The SDKs also advertise programmatic item management. These cover bulk transfer and listing only; general multi-item operations like batch edit, move or delete are not documented, and scripting them through the CLI or SDK is a developer building block. Missing for 10: documented batch edit/move/delete commands or APIs, bulk operations exposed to AI agents, and hands-on or independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once

citations.quote: You can import data into 1Password from many different browsers and applications, including applications that export data in the comma-separated values (CSV) file format
